title: Normal force at D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point D using centripetal force equation N = m*v^2/R - mg, yielding 0.3 N.

title: Speed at point B
description: Essential: Correctly applies work-energy theorem from B to D, accounting for friction on BC and gravity on CD, to find v_B = sqrt(v_D^2 + 2μgl + 4gR) = 2√3 m/s.

title: Condition for reaching D
description: Important: Identifies the critical condition at D for just reaching it: mg = m*v_D1^2/R, leading to v_D1 = sqrt(gR).

title: Condition for landing on BC
description: Important: Uses projectile motion from D to determine the horizontal velocity v_D2 needed to land on BC: l = v_D2 * t, with t = sqrt(4R/g).

title: Work-energy from A to D
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem from A to D correctly: change in kinetic energy equals work done by electric field minus work by friction and gravity.

title: Potential difference range
description: Essential: Solves the inequalities from the two conditions to obtain the final range for U_AB: -320 V < U_AB < 160 V.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to work done by electric force (qU_AB) or friction/gravity, leading to wrong inequality direction.

title: Centripetal force direction
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign in normal force equation at D (e.g., N = mg + mv^2/R) or misapplies the condition for just reaching D.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Ensures all quantities are in SI units before substitution and includes correct units in final answers.
